verse: navamena sthitisthena lāṃcchitaṃ kuru mantrarāṭ | mahāśabdaṃ tatoddhṛtya mātṛśabdamataḥ param
eṣā śatākṣarā vidyā sthiticakrasya pūraṇe | samayā sarvathā nātha samadurvāritā satī
tataḥ kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ khaḍgahasto vidhānait | cīraṃ vīravaraḥ śreṣṭho yoginī vātha bhairava
See chapter 15/59 of the Aajñākhaṇḍa śrīmadduttaradigbhāge pīṭhaṃ pīṭhavaraṃ mahat | oḍḍiyānābhidhānante siddhiyoginisevitam
nāsattā na ca sattā vā sattāsattobhayojjhitam | avedyam vedakatve'aapi sākaṃ ko pacanārthataḥ
gurupāraṃparāyātaṃ vyomeśīnāṃ ca hṛdgatam | akathyaṃ paramaṃ yat tu mahārtha buddhidaṃ sadā
tasmiṃ cakre mahāghore mahāmātṛbhiḥ saṃkule | svavimarśadaśanibhā * * * * * * * *(?)
prathamaḥ  paṭalaḥ ||1/1 ||
agnibījaṃ tataḥ paścāt mahāśabdamataḥ param | eṣā pañcākṣarī vidyā siddhānāṃ tattvadarśinī
etacchrutvā  tu vacanaṃ aśarīrāccharīriṇam  ||1/ 62 ||
kathayasva prasādena kramasadbhāvamuttamam | yena jñātena vai samyak svasvarūpatayā sthitaḥ
krameṇa sarva tu * *? sthitiḥ sā sarvatomukhī | tataḥ saṃhārakāraṇī kramavijñānabhakṣaṇī
tava snehena vakṣyāmi vistareṇa yathāvidhiḥ  ||2/25 ||
jñātavyāḥ sarvathā nātha aśarīrāccharīragāḥ | etāstu mūrtayaḥ proktāḥ khecakrapadadarśikāḥ
ṣodaśaṃtaṃ vijānīyāt sarvakālaṃ mahāmate | sṛṣṭipañcamakaṃ yad vai saṃhārāt saptame yutam
pūjitavyaṃ prayatnena sarvagrasanalolupam | rakṣayet prāṇavad yatnena caurebhyo draviṇaṃ yathā
siddhāśca parameśāni tvatprasādāvatāritāḥ | pāramparyakramāyātā mukhāmukhayane sthitāḥ
vaktrena parameṇaiva sarvasaṃhārakena ca ||2/13 ||
yena dṛṣṭena labdhena jñānena paramārthataḥ | dhyānena smaraṇenaiva guruṇoktena karmaṇā
vyomeśyaśca tathā devyo vyomaśca pūjayet sudhīḥ | sācaniḥ kramadūtīśca śaktiḥ puṣkarameva ca
sarvamantrāraṇī yā vai mantrabhūmistu sā viduḥ | etāstu mantrasiddhā vai bhūmayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ
śrībhairava uvāca śrutaṃ me devadeveśi śāntaraśmisvarūpakam | aṣṭānāṃ tu yathā tathyaṃ yoginīnāṃ svabhāvagam
namo'stu devi ādau ca madhye tubhyaṃ namo'stu te | etat stutipadaṃ kṛtvā tathedaṃ vākyamabravīt
tatrasthāstu imāḥ sarvā āgatāstu svabhāvataḥ | aṣṭāvaṣṭaguṇā divyāḥ svabhāvārādhanotsukāḥ
sadāśivo  bhairavaśca   nāgairnāgavaraistathā  ||1/ 47 ||
raśmirūpā nirācārā bhāvābhāvakṣaye ratāḥ | khaṃ prāptāḥ śaktimārgena tad vada me trilocane
ratnākārā ratnagarbhā ratnakāntarabhāsakā  ||2/31 ||
sṛṣṭilakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ prathamaṃ varṇanāyakam | viddhi bhairava tattvena sarvasaubhāgyadāyakam
carate sarvagānte yā mantrabhūmistu sā viduḥ | kodaṇḍe tu catudaṇḍā (?) daṇḍāntadvayadaṇḍaṇī
anulome pramānākhyāṃ kālaṃsaṃkarṣayet paraṃ | (?) kālasya sarvabhakṣasya hehaṃ vai kalāsaṃbhavam
trayodaśantu saṃhārāt sṛṣṭinavamasaṃyutam | aṣṭamena adhaḥkrāntaṃ caturdaśamasaṃyutam
yoginīnāṃ paraṃ sāraṃ vidhānaṃ kramaśāsanam | siddhakrameṇa āyātaṃ pāraṃparyakramāgatam
bhūtādiviṣayairyuktā pūjyā bhasmavilepanī | ṛsyaṣṭakaṃ tataḥ pujyaṃ paścād vidyām prapūjayet
uttamā sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ gopayet prāṇavallabhe | agopyād siddhihāniḥ syād gopānāt tu phalapradā
kuhūkāntā purā jñātvā sā kāmād mocayiṣyati | tatrasthā tu svabhāvasthā carahīnā taraṅgitā
prāpyase paramaṃ jñeyaṃ sarvajñeyeṣu cottamam | śrībhairava uvāca śrutaṃ me parameśāni sṛṣṭicakrasya pūjanam
āṇave paramānande mantrabhūmistu sā viduḥ | antaḥpade sthitā kācid dṛśyādṛśyaistu varjitā
mantrabhūmestu tā devi bhūmayaḥ saṃprakīrtitāḥ | caturviṃśatibhedānāṃ samyag sūtraṃ prakāśayet
saṃhāraṃ bhakṣayennityaṃ daśasaptākṣarā tu sā | khecarīcakracāreṇa samayāṃ cārayet sadā
mantrāṇāṃ paramārthena bhūmayaḥ satatoditāḥ | idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi vidhyuddiṣṭena karmaṇā
ūrdhvati vikalāntañca taśārmadhyasthitā sthitiḥ | abuddhā tu sadā buddhā bodhake vidhitā na * ?
tridhāvasthaṃ tridhāmādyaṃ tripravāsaṃ tricetanam | trimūrtiḥ tripathaṃ ramyaṃ akṣaraṃ acyutaṃ śivam
namaḥ kṛtāntadurdāntakālasya karaṇodyate | namo māyādivaibhavyai viśvajṛmbhe rakṣa me
navamena sthitisthena lāṃcchitaṃ kuru bhairava | tṛtīyametat kathitaṃ caturthamadhunā śṛṇu
ṣoḍaśānāṃ tu yad  jñeyaṃ jñānarūpaṃ parāparam ||2/26 ||
sarvasaṃhārakaṃ dīptaṃ nirguṇaṃ vyomavartinam | tena bhāvena sarvajña kālanirnāśanaṃ param
mantrabhūmiṃ prayacchanti sādhakānāṃ tu nityaśaḥ | tasmāt sarvaprayatnena pūjyā vandyāḥ stutāḥ sadā
tatastu bhāsācakrasya ārūḍhā sarvatomukhī | dvāda śānāṃ tu kalāntaṃ vai dvidhā cidbhā taraṅgiṇī
paśya tvaṃ prakaṭaṃ candraṃ gopitaṃ sarvajantuṣu | vyomni vyomagataṃ bhūtvā śṛṇuṣvedamabhāvagam
abhāvena tu sā devi jñānena samatāṃ gatā | haṭhabhāvā svabhāvasthā aṭavyāṃ haṭhamadhyagā
mahāvane mahāghore gahane harṣadāyine | mahāhave'aatha bhīme vā vīragrasanalampaṭe
na jñānaṃ na ca vijñeyaṃ melāpaṃ paramaṃ na ca | na sṛṣṭirna ca saṃhāraṃ sthitibhāsāvivarjitam
sṛṣṭiḥ sthitiśca saṃhāraṃ anākhyeyaṃ caturthakam | bhāsā śrutaṃ ca saddṛṣṭyā kramametat mahārthakam
yogināṃ svātma niṣṭānāṃ bodhitvā samatāṃ sakṛt | sphurate yā akrāmena sā sṛṣṭiḥ sarvatomukhī
astināstipadairhīnā sthitirūpā krameṇa tu | antasthā bhūtasaṃghasya svarasya pararūpiṇī | arūḍharūḍhayormadhye uttarottaragarbhiṇī
śūnyaṃ śūnyaṃ tathā śūnyaṃ tiśūnyaṃ śūnyavarjitam | śūnyajñānamidaṃ rudra jñātvā śūnyāntayobhavet
śrībhairavyuvāca śṛṇu bhairava tattvena praśnaṃ tu paramārthataḥ | aṣṭa pīṭhāstu ye proktāḥ sarvapīṭheṣu cottamāḥ
aṣṭamena adhaḥkrāntaṃ caturdaśamasaṃyutam | sthitivarṇamavarṇena līlayā lāṃchitaṃ kuru
sthitirūpaṃ mahāntaṃ vai ṣoḍaśāraṃ tu viśvagam | tadbāhye tu paraṃ divyaṃ nāma datvā prayatnataḥ
śrībhairavyūvāca śṛṇu sarvaṃ samāsena sṛṣṭicakrasya sarvataḥ | samayāṃpūrayet sadyaḥ bāhyataḥ parameśvara
varṇatrayodaśaṃ taṃ tu viddhi śatrunisūdana | sthitisthaṃ tu dvitīye na caturdaśamameva ca
sṛṣṭisthaṃ viddhi sarvajña saptamaṃ tvadhunā śṛṇu | sthitisthaṃ tu dvitīyaṃ syāt sṛṣṭiṣaṣṭhena saṃyutam
etat sadrūpaṃ deveśi kathitaṃ tava bhārgaśam | gopayed yonivad yatnādaguptād narakaṃ bhavet
eṣā vidyā tu mūrtināṃ sarvasvaṃ kālikākrame | tataḥ saṃjñā prakartavyā guruṇocchinnakarmaṇā
varṇaistu vanatau? * *? mantrabhūmistu sā viduḥ | kahīnā kādyagā svasthā kālākālakṣayākulā
sthitāṃ varṇasvabhāvena akṣarākṣararūpiṇīm | śrībhairavyuvāca śṛṇu māṃ paramāṃ vidyāṃ sarvakāmaphalapradām
saṃhāracakre deveśa trayodaśaṃ samuddharet | sṛṣṭidaśena saṃyuktaṃ aṣṭamena adhoyutam
ānandapadamadhyasthe ābhāsānte namo'stu te | āhlādapadagarbhe tu vyāptirūpe namo'stu te
śrībhairava uvāca asmin pīṭhe mahābhīme vīravīraiḥ susaṃkule | kimarthamāgatāḥ sarve catuḥṣaṣṭirmahābalāḥ
kiṃ tadbhāvagaṃ bhāvaṃ vā kiṃ vā bhāveṣu madhyagam | kiṃ vā ādyamanādyaṃ vā kiṃ vā ādyantamadhyagam
sṛṣṭicakrasyayad varṇaṃ saptamaṃ ghorarūpakam | saṃhārādaṣṭame yuktaṃ ekādaśamanuttamam
2/? ghrātā ghrātā vinirmuktā jñānena samatāṃ gatā | ? pañcānāṃ svasvabhāvānāṃ tridhāmā sā vyavasthitā
etaccaturthaṃ kathitaṃ pañcamaṃ tvadhunā śṛṇu | sthiticakrasya deveśa daśamaṃ sarvakāmadam
viddhi bhairava tattvena dvādaśaṃ tvadhunā śṛṇu | sṛṣṭipañcamagaṃ yacca dvādaśaṃ taṃ viduḥ priya
yoginīvīravīraiśca vīrajāḥ parameśvari | tvayārādhanasaṃsaktā mahāyogendrāḥ sotsukāḥ
etat te kathitaṃ vīra mantroddharaṃ paraṃ śubham | śrībhairava uvāca śrutaṃ me tava vaktrābjād vidyā sarvārthasādhakī
sṛṣṭikramaṃ tu prathamaṃ anantaraṃ dvitīyakam | saṃhāraṃ tu tṛtīyaṃ syādanākhyeyaṃ caturthakam
yena pūjitamātreṇa sthitijño bhavase haraḥ | pūjyaṃ tat sarvakālaṃ vai madyairmmāṃsairyathāvidhiḥ
3/(?) a? anto tu amātrā sarvām matryalaṃtu sarvadā | (?) prakaṭasthā tu sā kālī sarvasaṃhārakārikā
vāgbhavaṃ tu tato yojyaṃ kāmarājaṃ tatoddharet | sthitisthaṃ tu tato rudra dvitīyaṃ viśvarūpakam
pūjanīyā prayatnena saṃsiddhikārikā kṣiti | ? tatrasthā devadeveśyo vijñānakramayogataḥ
iti śrīmaduttarapīṭhavinirgate śrīśrīnāthapādāvatārite śrīkālikākramasadbhāve mahārthakramāvatāro nāma tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥ
tasyāḥ sthānaṃ tu bhāvajña asthānaṃ sthānameva ca | pūjā tasyāstabhāvautthā indriyārthasya preraṇāt
mūrtināṃ vyomagā nātha yathānyāyaṃkramagatāḥ | sṛṣṭicakrasya yad varṇaṃ prathamaṃ śaktirūpakam
sthiticakrasya deveśa daśamantraṃ samuddharet | caturthaṃ tat vijānīyāt sarvaiśvaryapravatakam
nityayuktā vidhānajñāḥ sarve sarveṣu cāgragāḥ | tvayā suśrūṣaṇe ratā atyantamuditānanāḥ
madhyaspandarathārūḍhā asvarāmbarabhedinī | vādyantā ūrdhvagā kālī hayāntā tūṣṇīgāśrutā
kuṃdayāgavibhāgeṣu (?) yoginīnāṃ tu sarvataḥ | tacchṛṇuṣva samāsena bhavabandhanisūdana
manonmani śive paścāt mahāśabdamataḥ param | balaśabdamataḥ paścāt parākramapadaṃ tataḥ
tava vaktrād viniryātaṃ vidhānaṃ tattvarūpakam | jñānaṃ sāṇavamelāpaṃ śāktaṃ śāṃbhavameva ca
kharaṇḍāṇḍe mahācaṇḍā caṇḍatejaḥsvarūpiṇī | tena mārgeṇa sā raśmiḥ śaktirūpā khamāgatā
sṛṣṭisaṃhārake jñāne sthitikartrī (?) samudyatā | ooṃkārā ooṃgatā ādyā oṣadhīnāṃ svarūpadā
tato vakṣyāmyaśeṣeṇa hṛdgataṃ kramaśāsanam | sarvamantreṣu yat sāraṃ sarvajñāneṣu cottamam
prāpyate paramaṃ cakraṃ khacakramakulaṃ kulam | tasmāt tvaṃ tu mahāvīra paryāye bhāvyate sadā
surakṣitaṃ pradātavyaṃ sādhakāya mahātmanaḥ | etāsāṃ yoginīnāṃ ca guruvaktragatāni ca
tacchṛṇuṣva samāsena sārāt sārataraṃ śubham ||2/17 ||
sṛṣṭisthaṃ pañcamaṃ viddhi daśamaṃ taṃ viduḥ priye | saṃhārāṣṭaṃ tu dvitīyaṃ sṛṣṭiaṣṭamasaṃyutam
etat tṛtīyaṃ deveśa caturthamadhunā śṛṇu | daśamaṃ sṛṣṭicakrasya saṃhārodaṣṭanairyutam
dvādaśāntā nirānandā śoḍaśāntā manonmanī | punardvyaṣṭakalāyātā dvau daśaṣaṭtrita ekam
catuḥṣaṣṭistu yoginyo mahārthapadagarvitāḥ ||1/ 68 ||
